plain: A surgeon from Brazil named Italo Venturelli, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, talks about a man named James Fox. He says people have already tried to sell Fox many videos, but that they are not real. It is told as a warning that fake footage gets offered to people looking into these stories.
